rationale: The telemetry from the last race indicated that the robot struggled with stability, as evidenced by a high number of line loss events (3 out of 8) and a significant rms error of 0.017809. To improve stability and control, I have decided to keep the body width at 0.18m, maintain the wheel track at 0.16m, and increase the sensor size to 0.016m to enhance detection capabilities. The controller parameters have been set to base_speed: 0.1, kp: 0.5, ki: 0.1, kd: 0.05, and line_loss: 'search_left' to optimize performance based on the geometry. These changes should further enhance the robot's balance and reduce line loss events, leading to better performance in future races.
